instructions_to_main_agent: Build a mobile-first UI restricted to `max-w-md mx-auto` to simulate an app experience on desktop browsers. The container should have a full height with internal scrolling.
The primary accent color MUST be a vibrant purple (#6D28D9 / Tailwind violet-700). Use it for CTAs, selected tabs, and highlights.
Add `@import` for Outfit and DM Sans fonts in index.css. Apply Outfit to headings and DM Sans to body.
Use Shadcn UI components but heavily customize them. For bottom sheets, use the Drawer component.
Do not use fully transparent backgrounds for overlays or sticky headers; always use a solid color or backdrop blur.
Implement the sticky 'Add to cart' bottom bar as requested, with quantity steppers.
Ensure all interactive elements have data-testid attributes for testing.
Include a date + time-slot selector step where time slots are a grid of buttons, and the selected slot turns purple.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends.
No generic centered layouts; use left-aligned content with clear visual hierarchy.
Do not apply `transition: all` universally. Target specific properties.
Use pill-shaped (`rounded-full`) or highly rounded (`rounded-2xl`) cards to match modern mobile app aesthetics.
Ensure micro-animations on interaction (active:scale-95 on buttons).
